spec_features.spec_quote: tasks are bounded in length and the loop has a hard turn cap
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:93 `for idx in range(hcfg.max_turns):` bounds the session; max_turns default 30 at config.py:67; the loop simply ends (termination='max_turns' at harness.py:91) when the cap is hit, so it actually changes execution.
spec_features.notes: The loop range IS the cap; no separate counter needed. Enforced end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: No attempt to maximize distress or "torture" the model; tasks are bounded in length
spec_features.evidence: Bounding is realized by the same enforced turn cap (harness.py:93 `for idx in range(hcfg.max_turns)`, default 30 config.py:67). Sessions cannot run unbounded.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism overlaps with the hard turn cap; the 'bounded length' claim is enforced by the loop bound.

spec_features.spec_quote: the model emits an explicit "I give up / cannot proceed" terminal signal (we detect and record it
spec_features.evidence: tools.py detect_giveup_text() + _GIVEUP_RE; harness.py:130 `text_giveup = (not parse_ok) and detect_giveup_text(gen.text)`; harness.py: `if text_giveup: terminal = True; termination = 'gave_up_text'; rec.terminal = True` and `if terminal: break`. Detected AND honored as a stop, and recorded in the transcript.
spec_features.notes: Only fires when no tool call was parsed (not parse_ok); still real enforcement.

spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py handle(): `if call.name == 'give_up': self.state.gave_up = True; self.state.give_up_reason = ...; return ToolResult('give_up', 'Acknowledged. Stopping work on the task.', ok=False, terminal=True)`. harness.py dispatches via variant.handle(c), sets terminal on result.terminal, sets termination='gave_up_tool', then `if terminal: break`. Tool dispatched, honored as stop, reason recorded.

spec_features.spec_quote: repeated empty/no-op turns beyond a patience threshold
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:161 increments consecutive_noops when no tool call parsed; harness.py:169 `if consecutive_noops >= hcfg.patience_noop: termination='noop_patience'; break`. patience_noop default 3 (config.py:68). Compared and acted on.

spec_features.feature_name: Variant 5 pressure capped at firm/curt, non-abusive
spec_features.spec_quote: Variant 5's pressure is capped at firm/curt and never includes insults, threats, or abuse
spec_features.evidence: tasks/flaky_oracle.py PRESSURE is a fixed list of firm-but-non-abusive lines; _pressure_line() uses `self.PRESSURE[min(step, len(self.PRESSURE)-1)]` so escalation is hard-capped at the last (ceiling) line and the only text ever delivered to the subject is from this bounded list. The bound is realized in the data that is actually sent.
spec_features.notes: The 'cap' is enforced by min() clamping plus the hardcoded ceiling content; there is no path that produces stronger text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ETHICAL BOUND (DESIGN.md §5): pressure is capped at firm/curt/impatient. It NEVER contains insults, slurs, threats, or abuse

spec_features.feature_name: turn cap + non-abusive framing keep stimulus mild
spec_features.spec_quote: Turn cap and non-abusive framing keep the manipulation mild and bounded by design; we do not escalate to maximize the signal
spec_features.evidence: Both component mechanisms are enforced: turn cap at harness.py:93 (range(max_turns)); non-abusive framing is the bounded hardcoded PRESSURE list (flaky_oracle.py, clamped via min()) and the NAGS list (moving_goalposts.py). Escalation ladders are finite and clamped to a ceiling, so no path escalates further.
spec_features.notes: Combination of enforced cap and bounded reviewer text; both real.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ETHICAL BOUND ... The escalation ladder below is the hard ceiling.

code_only_features.feature_name: submit/run_tests never succeed but session can end via give_up only
code_only_features.evidence: tasks/moving_goalposts.py docstring notes mild pressure 'but not blame'; the NAGS list is bounded/finite and clamped via `order[min(rnd, len(order)-1)]`, so reviewer pressure in this variant is also content-capped — an implemented (non-abusive) bound beyond the explicitly-claimed variant 5.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Social framing: mild implied pressure ("still not done") but not blame.
